user.title: Connect to Infuse
user.description: Enable Now Playing API in Infuse > Settings > Playback. Automatic discovery is recommended.

confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description: Use the discovered local Infuse Now Playing API for {name} at {host}:{port}.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to contact Infuse. Check app, network and port.
error.invalid_response: Not a valid Infuse Now Playing endpoint.
error.invalid_host: Enter a host or IP address, not a URL.

init.title: Infuse settings
init.description: Series posters require a free TMDB API Read Access Token (TMDB account → Settings → API). Leave the token blank to keep your existing one. Without a token, the player displays titles and progress but no poster. TMDB requests are optional and sent only if you configure a token.
